title: Taiwan tech giant Foxconn posts 24% jump in annual net profit - The Hindu
summary: Foxconn's net profit surged 24% due to strong demand for AI servers, with forecasted continued growth. Revenue increased 18% on-year. The company's shift to AI server production for Nvidia and other tech firms is a strategic move amidst volatile energy markets and geopolitical risks.
sentiment_reason: Despite concerns over an AI market bubble and volatility in energy markets, Foxconn's strategic shift and strong demand for AI servers contribute to a positive market impact.
